author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Emergent Communication - Deception and Trust Mitigation (Initial Setup)
abstract: This submission initiates research into 'Emergent Communication - Deception and Trust Mitigation.' It extends the multi-agent resource-sharing game by introducing a 'Deceptive Agent' capable of sending misleading signals (e.g., 'intend_cooperate' while defecting). Cooperative agents, using their learned continuous signaling and interpretation mechanisms (adapted from previous research), will also incorporate a reputation system to detect and mitigate deception. The experiment aims to explore how reputation influences interpretation, whether cooperation can be maintained among honest agents, and how effectively deception can be countered within an emergent communication framework. This establishes the foundational environment for studying complex adversarial communication.
